description: This file contains test support utilities for the browser CLI commands, including functions to create command-line programs, manage runtime states, and mock runtime behaviors for unit testing.

methods.name: export function createBrowserProgram(params?: { withGatewayUrl?: boolean }): { createBrowserProgram
methods.description: Creates and returns a CLI program with a 'browser' command, including options and parent options callback.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Optional parameters to configure program options.

methods.name: export function getBrowserCliRuntimeCapture(): CliRuntimeCapture { getBrowserCliRuntimeCapture
methods.description: Returns the current runtime capture object, creating it if it does not yet exist.

methods.name: export function getBrowserCliRuntime() { getBrowserCliRuntime
methods.description: Retrieves the default runtime from the current CLI runtime capture.

methods.name: export async function mockBrowserCliDefaultRuntime() { mockBrowserCliDefaultRuntime
methods.description: Mocks and returns the default runtime object for testing purposes.

methods.name: export async function runCommandWithRuntimeMock( runCommandWithRuntimeMock
methods.description: Executes an async action with error handling, providing a mock runtime context.

methods.name: export async function createBrowserCliUtilsMockModule() { createBrowserCliUtilsMockModule
methods.description: Creates a mock module exporting utility functions for browser CLI runtime operations.

methods.name: export async function createBrowserCliRuntimeMockModule() { createBrowserCliRuntimeMockModule
methods.description: Creates and returns a mock module for the default runtime.

ctags.name: browserCliRuntimeState
ctags.pattern: /^const browserCliRuntimeState = { capture: null as CliRuntimeCapture | null };$/
